text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The last of the chrysanthemums are<n>still in bloom
here in Kyoto, and we're<n>going to see another
bloom today!<n>Hold on, folks—the Queen Elizabeth II
Cup is about to begin!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Dober... It's finally here. I know<n>you've been
waiting for this day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Bright... You came.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Of course. ♪ After all...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: This is the beginning of your story,<n>no?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Here is where your shining Mejiro<n>legacy begins.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yes. That's right.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Well then, I couldn't possibly miss<n>this race! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Dober, my most kindred of spirits—I<n>wish you the
best of luck today. Go<n>out there and show them
what you<n>can do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Oh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I have been awaiting this day.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I, Air Groove the Empress, shall face<n>you with
every fiber of my being.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: It is time for our battle, Mejiro Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I've been waiting for today too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I won't hold anything back either. I'll<n>run against
you with everything I've<n>got!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Heh.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I shall see you on the track.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Do you still believe in my strength,<n>even now?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I don't even have to think about my<n>answer. After
all, I'll tell her as many<n>times as she needs me to.
choice_data_list: Mejiro Dober, you are an incredible racer.
Mejiro Dober, you are an incredible racer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Right.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Then keep your eyes on me, and<n>don't you even
think about blinking.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I will carve my name into history...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: And take flight towards my new<n>legacy!
